guard: ps --wide labels each seat's record as its operational facts are labeled, and leaves out a field the seat leaves empty
why: The suite drives the built binary against a live manager, so the mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The suite stops at its first failed check, so it declares no completion marker: a red run never reaches the end.

mutations.name: ps --wide labels a record with the table headers
mutations.expectRed: ps --wide adds operational facts without duplicating model or requested variant
mutations.cell: ps --wide adds operational facts without duplicating model or requested variant
